zypper_auto_refresh.description: Enable automatic refresh of repository metadata before zypper operations.

zypper_gpg_check.description: Enable GPG signature verification for repository metadata and packages.

zypper_solver_focus.description: Default solver focus mode: Job, Installed, or Update.

zypper_solver_only_requires.description: If true, the solver ignores recommended packages (onlyRequires). If false, it installs recommended packages as well.

zypper_repo_refresh_delay.description: Delay in seconds before automatic metadata refresh is triggered again.

zypper_distroverpkg.description: The package name used to derive $releasever for repository URL substitution.
